notes.title: The demo is now available! & new capsules for the game
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, I've added a demo on Steam where you can test out a bit of the game and its mechanics. Unfortunately, the demo doesn't look quite as I'd like, but it will be updated and eventually become part of the full game. I'm still working on the full version of the game, but creating it solo isn't easy. In a few weeks, I'll try to patch the current demo, fix bugs, and the next demo update will add a menu and additional levels.


Additionally, I finally received some graphics of my game:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927103/a4b316206ca30fb57a4ea2f794caa3af41db26c8.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927103/e660bcc5e7cf1ef7eddb44caefceee64d55143d6.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927103/b1c8f254fcb2dcd79b76f9e310471b76256ef801.png"][/img]There are exactly 3360 people who have added the game to their wishlist. The milestone I have set for myself for now is 10,000.

I will inform you about further development of the game [b][i][u]on our discord!

[/u][/i][/b][/h3][h3][url="https://discord.gg/nHXPDqRs4V"]https://discord.gg/nHXPDqRs4V[/url][/h3]
